title: The review page shortens "Means of transport to the port of entry" to "Means of transport", so the summary no longer says which leg of the journey it describes
controls: Means of transport to the port of entry

finding.frontend: The Arrival details card on Check your answers labels the row "Means of transport" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/check-answers/copy/copy.en.js:71). The question that collected the answer is labelled in full — "Means of transport to the port of entry" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/transport/copy/copy.en.js:16) — so the summary drops the part of the label that says which leg of the journey the answer is about, on the one page where a trader is checking answers out of the context of the question that asked for them.
finding.prototype: Design release 1 uses the same words on the review page as on the question: its Arrival details card labels the row "Means of transport to the port of entry" (app/routes.js:4680-4683).
finding.difference: Change the review row label to "Means of transport to the port of entry". It is one string, `rows.meansOfTransport` in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/check-answers/copy/copy.en.js:71, and it is used only by the Arrival details card.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding the words "to the port of entry" after "Means of transport" in the Arrival details card of fe-check-answers. The captured DOM's row key is exactly "Means of transport".
finding.verification: Ran the falsifier: grep for "Means of transport" plus any trailing words in capture/html/frontend/fe-check-answers.html returns exactly "Means of transport", and the same grep against capture/html/prototype/dr1-review-notification.html returns "Means of transport to the port of entry". Both are visible in the two page screenshots. Read the three strings: check-answers/copy/copy.en.js:71 is the short review label, transport/copy/copy.en.js:16 is the full fieldset legend on the question page, and app/routes.js:4680-4681 is the requirements side's review row key. Confirmed the review label is used only by the Arrival details card by grepping rows.meansOfTransport across the check-answers view-model. CORRECT.

relatedTo.why: The two row labels sit next to each other in the same Arrival details card on the same page.
